description: Read the eBay offers of up to 25 products live and return, per offer, the fulfillment, payment and return policy ids it carries now, the shipping policy name, its eBay site and status (PUBLISHED = live, UNPUBLISHED = draft), and matchesAssignment — whether it carries the product's own choice in the CRM (null when the product has none). Products with no draft or live listing are listed in withoutOffer; notAttempted were not reached in the time budget — call again with those ids. Reads only. Use get_product_ebay_fulfillment_policy for one product's full picture.

productIds.description: The products whose eBay offers to read, at most 25 ids from search_products.

items.description: A product id returned by search_products.
